body.objective: Resolve the k=0 and low-j scalar, vector, tensor, homogeneous and stabilizer blocks left open by the generic Berger scalar nonclosure theorem.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal full-isotypical generic-block result and the scalar obstruction. Construct the complete right-neutral k=0 closure for every integer j>=1, the j=0 homogeneous block and every low-j vector/tensor exception under q70. Derive exact 70-row actions and cotangent lifts for SU(2)_L x U(1)_R, D, R_rel, K and diagonal U1, prove their commutators, q70 equivariance, cyclicity and moment-map identities, and classify every exceptional class as local gauge, charged global orbit, stabilizer, action-angle family tangent, radical or physical cohomology on unrestricted and fixed-charge carriers separately. Export exact maps, pairings and characteristic/Jordan blocks or the first exact closure obstruction, with independent bracket/PBW verifiers, mutations, schema, receipt, report and atlas fragment.
body.current_gate: right-neutral and exceptional completion of the closed isotypical carrier
body.forbid: no vanishing first PBW defect called full closure; no generic formula used for low-j exceptions; no K called raw D; no global charged symmetry deleted as gauge; no fixed/unrestricted carrier conflation; no all-Hodge, observer or quantum promotion
body.resource_hint: EXCEPTIONAL FOLLOW-UP. k=0 only passed the first defect test; this task must prove complete closure before computing a quotient.
